info.title: Seed Audio 1.5 Audio Generation
info.description: Generate up to six minutes of dialogue, narration, sound effects, and music from a prompt. Optionally provide one reference image or up to six voice samples.

post.description:
> 🚧 **This model is not yet available.**

- Generate dialogue, narration, effects, and music from a prompt. Provide either `1` reference image or up to `6` audio clips for voice matching or multi-speaker dialogue. Use only one reference type per request.
- Generate up to `6` minutes of audio per request.
- Include the exact lines to speak in the prompt. Generating only music or sound effects is unsupported.
- Processing is asynchronous. Use the returned task ID to [check the result](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail). Tasks cannot be cancelled after submission.
- Output links expire after 7 days. Save the files before then.

**Billing**

- Billing is based on generated audio duration in seconds, rounded up to the next whole second.
- At submission, `usage.credits_reserved` is estimated from the prompt length. The final charge uses the actual audio duration. Excess credits are refunded and any shortfall is charged. Failed tasks receive a full refund.

**Task results when `status` is `completed`**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `results[0]` / `result_data[0].audio_url` | Audio URL. |
| `result_data[0].duration` | Audio duration in seconds. |
| `result_data[0].subtitles` | Subtitles in the form `[{"format": "srt", "content": "…"}, {"format": "jsonl", "content": "…"}]`. Each JSONL line contains one word and its start and end times in seconds. |
| `usage.billed_seconds` / `usage.credits_used` | Billed seconds and credits actually used, respectively. |

value.prompt: In a warm, clear female Mandarin voice, read the quoted line slowly: “今天的海面很平静。” Use voice only.
Recreate the beach scene in the image. Waves roll in the distance and a nearby gull calls twice. A Mandarin narrator softly says, “我们到了。” Speak only the quoted line.

dialogue.summary: Generate a two-person dialogue from two voice samples

value.prompt: Clip 1 is the host and clip 2 is the guest. In Mandarin, the host asks brightly, “这是你第一次听到海浪吗？” After half a second, the guest replies gently, “是的，比想象中更安静。” Speak only the two quoted lines.

prompt.description: Describe the sound and quote the exact lines to speak. Identify each speaker and language. Assign any reference clips to roles (for example, clip 1 is the host and clip 2 is the guest). Use `[start_seconds:end_seconds]` to time individual sounds.
prompt.example: In a warm, clear female Mandarin voice, slowly read only the quoted line: “你好，这是一次接口测试。” Use voice only.

image_urls.description:
Use `1` reference image to guide sound generation. **Do not combine with `audio_urls`.** Supply a public URL or base64 data such as `data:image/png;base64,…`.

- Width and height: `300`–`6000` pixels each. Aspect ratio: `0.4`–`2.5`.
- Formats: `jpeg`, `png`, `webp`, `bmp`, `tiff`, `gif`, `heic`, `heif`. File size must be **under** `10 MB`.

audio_urls.description:
Provide voice samples for voice matching or multi-speaker dialogue. **Do not combine with `image_urls`.**

- Supply up to `6` clips, numbered from 1 in array order. In `prompt`, assign each clip to a role (for example, clip 1 is the host and clip 2 is the guest).
- Use public URLs or base64 data (`data:audio/mp3;base64,…` or `data:audio/wav;base64,…`).
- Each clip must be `2`–`30` seconds long, up to `180` seconds in total.
- Formats: `wav` or `mp3`, up to `15 MB` per clip.

format.description:
Output audio format

- `wav` (default) or `mp3`
- `ogg_opus` supports only `48000` Hz.
- `pcm` returns raw 16-bit audio without a header. Standard media players need additional processing to play it.

sample_rate.description: Output sample rate in Hz. For `wav`, `mp3`, and `pcm`, choose any listed rate (default `44100`). For `ogg_opus`, the only valid rate is `48000`, which is selected automatically if omitted.

speech_rate.description: Speech rate as an integer from `-50` to `100`. At `0` (default), speech plays at normal speed. `100` is about twice as fast and `-50` is about half speed.

loudness_rate.description: Volume as an integer from `-50` to `100`. `0` is the normal volume (default). `100` is about twice as loud and `-50` is about half as loud.

pitch_rate.description: Pitch adjustment in **semitones**, from `-12` to `12`. `0` (default) leaves pitch unchanged. `12` raises it one octave and `-12` lowers it one octave.

subtitles.description:
Include subtitles.

`true` returns the subtitle text in both `srt` and `jsonl` formats in the task result. The default is `false` (no subtitles).

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback URL invoked when the task finishes

**When it fires:**
- Triggered when the task is completed, failed, or cancelled
- Sent after billing is finalized

**Security restrictions:**
- HTTPS only
- Callbacks to internal IP addresses are forbidden (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Up to `3` retries on failure (at `1` / `2` / `4` seconds after each failure)
- The callback body has the same format as the task-query response
- A 2xx response is treated as success; other status codes trigger a retry

can_cancel.description: Whether the task can be cancelled. This model does not support cancellation after submission.

credits_reserved.description: Credits reserved based on prompt length. The final charge uses the actual audio duration. Any difference is refunded or charged.

bearerAuth.description:
All endpoints require Bearer Token authentication

**Get your API Key:**

Visit the [API Key management page](https://evolink.ai/dashboard/keys) to obtain your API Key

```

```
